**UniV3LPLocker** Lock uniswap v3 lp ```Text solidity function lock( INonfungiblePositionManager nftManager_, uint256 nftId_, address owner_, address collector_, uint256 endTime_, string memory feeName_ ) external payable returns (uint256 lockId); ``` Relock ```Text solidity function relock(uint256 lockId_, uint256 endTime_) external; ``` Unlock ```Text solidity function unlock(uint256 lockId_) external; ``` Collect liquidity provider rewards ```Text solidity function collect( uint256 lockId_, address recipient_, uint128 amount0Max_, uint128 amount1Max_ ) ```

Ethereum TokenLocker 0xf17a08a7d41f53b24ad07eb322cbbda2ebdec04b only; direct nonproxy root with Sourcify exact_match creation/runtime source. Current official SafeToken Locker documentation lists this deployment. Other chains, UniV3/UniV4 lockers and price-lock interfaces are not admitted.

lock and vestingLock pull exactly amount from msg.sender into a recorded financial lock, not shared-pool prefunding. Existing token allowance is required and none is granted here. Fee-on-transfer/rebasing transfers that fail the exact balance-delta check revert. owner/params.owner is the irrevocable initial beneficiary; source does not reject zero beneficiary, so a zero or unintended beneficiary can strand funds.

Amounts use each token native decimals; times and cycle use seconds, vesting fractions use basis points (10000 denominator). Plain locks require positive amount and future endTime. Vesting requires future tgeTime, positive tgeBps/cycleBps and sum <=10000; cycle must be positive for any vesting release, although source does not enforce that at creation. Integer-floor TGE/cycle releases can round to zero; do not assume eventual release of tiny amounts.

Fees are mutable by owner and selected through feeName; docs fee tables are not a live quote. LP detection uses fixed factory/token0/token1/getPair static calls. LP fee floors amount*lpFee/10000, transfers that LP fee to its pair and burns to mutable feeReceiver; only the remaining amount is locked. Native lock fee requires exact msg.value when positive and fee token is zero; token fee is separately pulled from caller. Otherwise use zero native value: unused msg.value has no refund path.

updateLock is caller-owner-only, requires positive additional caller-funded tokens, no previously unlocked amount, and a strictly later endTime also in the future. It charges the stored feeName again and increases amount net of LP fee; no relock-only shortcut is provided.

unlock is caller-owner-only and pays the recorded owner. A plain lock returns its full remaining recorded amount once mature; vesting returns all currently accrued tranches, caps at recorded amount, and debits unlocked/cumulative ledgers. No early cancellation, yield return, price guarantee, transfer authority, permit or ownership-management method is admitted. Token/pair behavior and mutable fee configuration remain external dependencies.

Ethereum TokenLocker 0xf17a08a7d41f53b24ad07eb322cbbda2ebdec04b only; direct nonproxy root with Sourcify exact_match creation/runtime source. Current official SafeToken Locker documentation lists this deployment. Other chains, UniV3/UniV4 lockers and price-lock interfaces are not admitted.

lock and vestingLock pull exactly amount from msg.sender into a recorded financial lock, not shared-pool prefunding. Existing token allowance is required and none is granted here. Fee-on-transfer/rebasing transfers that fail the exact balance-delta check revert. owner/params.owner is the irrevocable initial beneficiary; source does not reject zero beneficiary, so a zero or unintended beneficiary can strand funds.

Amounts use each token native decimals; times and cycle use seconds, vesting fractions use basis points (10000 denominator). Plain locks require positive amount and future endTime. Vesting requires future tgeTime, positive tgeBps/cycleBps and sum <=10000; cycle must be positive for any vesting release, although source does not enforce that at creation. Integer-floor TGE/cycle releases can round to zero; do not assume eventual release of tiny amounts.

Fees are mutable by owner and selected through feeName; docs fee tables are not a live quote. LP detection uses fixed factory/token0/token1/getPair static calls. LP fee floors amount*lpFee/10000, transfers that LP fee to its pair and burns to mutable feeReceiver; only the remaining amount is locked. Native lock fee requires exact msg.value when positive and fee token is zero; token fee is separately pulled from caller. Otherwise use zero native value: unused msg.value has no refund path.

updateLock is caller-owner-only, requires positive additional caller-funded tokens, no previously unlocked amount, and a strictly later endTime also in the future. It charges the stored feeName again and increases amount net of LP fee; no relock-only shortcut is provided.

unlock is caller-owner-only and pays the recorded owner. A plain lock returns its full remaining recorded amount once mature; vesting returns all currently accrued tranches, caps at recorded amount, and debits unlocked/cumulative ledgers. No early cancellation, yield return, price guarantee, transfer authority, permit or ownership-management method is admitted. Token/pair behavior and mutable fee configuration remain external dependencies.
